A plain medium close-up of Roy, a man of seventy, standing against a plain warm magnolia wall, soft daylight from the left, the camera on a locked tripod, nothing else in frame. Audio is clean, close production dialogue sound: clear and even, with a little of the room's natural tone behind the voice. Breath and mouth detail are present but never exaggerated. No phone-microphone proximity, no compression pumping, no music and no sound effects anywhere in the clip — dialogue only.
